BiblicalUsage: Adaiah the son of Jeroham, and Maasiai the son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, stand in the priests who returned to Jerusalem. Maasiai's line runs through Jahzerah, and the priests proved their service by their fathers.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Jahzerah is named because the priesthood was restored by lineage: his grandson Maasiai served in Jerusalem, and the returning priests proved their right to serve by naming their fathers.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
